statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model_id=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.id'); short_model=$(echo "$model_id" | sed 's|.*profile/||'); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); branch=$(git -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "no-git"); session_id=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_id'); project_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.project_dir' | sed 's|/|-|g'); session_name=$(jq -r --arg sid "$session_id" '.entries[] | select(.sessionId == $sid) | .customTitle // empty' ~/.claude/projects/"$project_dir"/sessions-index.json 2>/dev/null); tar_project=$(grep -m1 '^TAR_PROJECT=' "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.project_dir')/.Renviron" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2); project_suffix=$([ -n "$tar_project" ] && echo " {$tar_project}" || echo ""); if [ -n "$session_name" ]; then echo "[$session_name] $short_model in $cwd [$branch]$project_suffix"; else echo "$short_model in $cwd [$branch]$project_suffix"; fi
